about: Perf guard policy (docs/BUILD_PROFILE.md "Perf guard"). independent_units: sections that work through independent units (frames, maps) but do not record a unit count; they get the FIX-NOW check. waivers: known violations, each with its bug ID, the job that owns the fix and an expiry date; a waiver ends at its date or when the bug register marks its bug fixed.

waivers.reason: the image stair walk on 1-2 of 24 cores (11.6 cores in the dev4 full build); the stairs-rc1 job fixes the walk
the frame-map heap check on one core; the vivec-b job parallelizes it
PERSISTING: the chim stage's heap gate, validation and zone walk on one core; repaired in source on v0.0.36-chim-speed, not on the line yet
